scope: Admin catalog Categories edit form: category ACTIVE/INACTIVE visibility toggle (server-owned status, storefront-hidden)

businessFlow.subject: Admin edits a category and toggles its status between Active (storefront-visible) and Inactive (storefront-hidden, still reactivatable in admin), with the list showing a muted Inactive pill

notes: Category status now supports ACTIVE/INACTIVE (migration 0050 relaxes the two CHECK constraints) in addition to ARCHIVED/DELETE. The edit modal has a Status select; saving a status change calls PATCH /api/v1/admin/categories/:id/status which is validated by the domain setCatalogStatus (never ARCHIVED — archive is a separate audited command) and audited as CATALOG_CATEGORY_DEACTIVATED/ACTIVATED. The admin list uses GET /api/v1/admin/categories (ACTIVE+INACTIVE, never ARCHIVED) so a deactivated category remains visible with a muted 'Inactive' pill and can be reactivated. The public storefront category endpoint stays ACTIVE-only, so the inactive category disappears from the storefront. Verified headed: deactivate -> 200, list shows Inactive, public endpoint excludes the category; reactivate -> 200, status restored.
